summary: Board-certified physician with nearly a decade of continuous full-time practice in outpatient and community health settings. Experienced in chronic disease management, preventive care, and leading multidisciplinary clinical teams.

experience.title: Physician
bullets: Provide comprehensive primary care to a panel of approximately 1,900 patients, managing chronic conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, and asthma through medication adjustment and ongoing monitoring.
Order and interpret laboratory, imaging, and diagnostic tests, integrating results into evidence-based treatment plans and documenting findings in the electronic health record.
Direct and coordinate the daily activities of nursing staff, medical assistants, and rotating students, including precepting trainees and reviewing care protocols.
Counsel patients on diet, activity, hygiene, and disease prevention, achieving a 22% increase in completed preventive screenings over two years.
Refer patients to cardiology, endocrinology, and behavioral health specialists as clinically indicated, coordinating shared care plans.

experience.title: Physician
bullets: Delivered full-spectrum medicine in a high-volume outpatient clinic, averaging 20-24 patient visits per day across all age groups.
Administered vaccinations, prescribed medications, and performed minor office procedures to treat and prevent acute and chronic illness.
Collected and maintained detailed patient histories, examination results, and progress notes to support continuity of care.
Collaborated with on-site behavioral health and nutrition staff to deliver integrated care for patients with complex needs.
Explained procedures and discussed test results with patients and caregivers, improving patient satisfaction scores by 15% year over year.

experience.title: Primary Care Physician
bullets: Managed a continuity panel focused on adult preventive care and chronic disease follow-up in an ambulatory setting.
Monitored patient conditions and reassessed treatment plans at scheduled intervals, adjusting therapy when outcomes fell short of targets.
Ordered and interpreted routine and specialized tests, analyzing records and examination information to diagnose conditions early.
Supervised medical assistants and nursing personnel, ensuring adherence to clinical guidelines and documentation standards.
Advised community members at health education events on lifestyle factors related to cardiovascular and metabolic disease.

experience.title: Resident Physician
experience.employer: a teaching hospital affiliated with a state university
bullets: Completed supervised training in outpatient and inpatient medicine, including preventive care, pediatrics, and women's health.
Collected patient histories, performed physical examinations, and presented assessments during daily rounds with attending physicians.
Prescribed and administered treatments and vaccinations under supervision while monitoring patient progress and treatment response.
Participated in didactic sessions and journal reviews, applying current evidence to diagnostic and therapeutic decisions.

education.institution: a state university school of medicine
